# The Salty Korean

> The Salty Korean is a blog by Randy Walker — the founder building Salty Poker Network, Texas' online poker platform. Covers the Texas poker industry, startup building, software engineering, and Korean-American life in Austin, TX.

## About

The Salty Korean (thesaltykorean.com) is the personal platform of Randy Walker, a Korean-American software engineer and entrepreneur based in Austin, Texas. Randy is the founder of SK Meridian LLC and creator of the Salty Poker Network (SPN) — an online poker platform built specifically for Texas players.

The blog sits at the intersection of several worlds:

**Texas Poker Industry**: First-hand analysis of the Texas poker landscape from someone actively building an online platform for it. Covers the private club model, how online poker works in Texas, why the industry needs disruption, and what players deserve.

**Startup Building**: Real, unfiltered stories from building a poker platform from scratch — architecture decisions, choosing the tick-fee model over rake, AI-assisted engineering, infrastructure challenges, and the day-to-day of being a solo technical founder.

**Software Engineering**: Technical deep dives on spec-driven development, cloud infrastructure, Jekyll/static sites, CI/CD, and building production-grade real-time systems.

**Korean-American Identity**: Cultural essays on immigrant family dynamics, finding identity at the intersection of Korean heritage and Texas culture, and what it means to build a business as a Korean-American in Austin.
